title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: A can of soup can feed \(3\) adults or \(5\) children. If there are \(5\) cans of soup and \(15\) children are fed, then how many adults would the remaining soup feed?

solutions.text:
Feeding \(15\) children uses \(15 \div 5 = 3\) cans, leaving \(5 - 3 = 2\) cans.

Those \(2\) cans feed \(2 \times 3 = 6\) adults.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: \(15\) children need \(15 \div 5 = 3\) cans, so find how many cans remain
